name: Moero! Taiikukai-kei Musume 2 - Hirose Rino Hen
original_name: 燃えろ!体育会系娘2 広瀬りの編
source:
Rino Hirose is an idol professional wrestler at the height of her popularity.
One day, she is tricked into asking for a handicap match between men and women.
However, it was a dark professional wrestling venue where anything was possible, with no contact with the outside world.
And she gets her body defiled in front of a large audience...
